Overview of Interaction Mediated by UGT Between Traditional Chinese Medicine and Drugs
Wang Zhe, Jiang Lili, Xia Yangliu, Liu Yong(School of Life Science and Medicine, Dalian University of Technology, Panjin 124221, China)Abstract: With the wide use of traditional Chinese medicine in the world and further understanding of the expression, function and regulation of UGT which is a major phase II metabolism enzyme, more and more attention has been paid to the study of the interaction mediated by UGT between multi-components, prescription of traditional Chinese medicine and chemical drugs. In this paper, the main research progress of interaction mediated by UGT between traditional Chinese medicine and drugs in recent years was reviewed and the prospect was put forward.Keywords: Drug-drug interaction, UDP-glucuronosyltransferase, traditional Chinese medicine（责任编辑：周哲琦，责任译审：王昭）
